chore(worklog): PR #59 merged, #48 closed

chore(worklog): PR #60 opened for #49

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>

fix(issue): default `issue list` to open issues (#60)

`tkt issue list` with no state flag returned open and closed issues,
although --help and doc/usage.md document the default as open only
(`pr list` already behaves that way). Nothing applied the default, so
the search query carried no is:open/is:closed qualifier.

- default `states` to ["open"] in `cmd_list`; the saved snapshot scope
  now matches the query actually sent
- `--all`, `--closed` and `--open --closed` behave as before; explicit
  issue refs to closed issues are still listed
- load `issue` snapshots stored with `states: null` as ["open"] so
  existing `issue list --watch` snapshots do not report a scope mismatch
  or need --diff-force; `pr` and `review` snapshots are untouched
- first --watch after upgrade shows previously tracked closed issues as
  one-time "gone" rows (data change, not a scope error)

Tests: query qualifier per flag combination, watch scope matching
(default == --open, --all differs), and old states:null snapshot
compatibility. Manually verified through the CLI (12/12) at the
approved head.

Fixes #49

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>
